description: Org-scoped actuation records: action class, authority, who/when, rollback state with reason, acknowledgement state. Config contents (from/to) are excluded. Requires the optimization_model_v3 flag (404 while off). Read-only. Response is envelope-shaped: every numeric leaf is a MeasuredValue {value, ci_low, ci_high, method, data_through}. ci fields are null unless the source payload carries a real confidence interval — never fabricated. Requires an API key with the 'read' scope.
name: metrx_get_actuations
title: Get Policy Actuations
